CanonicalVars.rationale: RoyalPoison.cs:16 is `new DamageVar(4m, ValueProp.Unblockable | ValueProp.Unpowered)` and AfterPlayerTurnStart passes the DynamicVar itself to CreatureCmd.Damage (line 23). DamageProps.NON_CARD_HP_LOSS is defined as exactly `ValueProp.UNBLOCKABLE | ValueProp.UNPOWERED` (valueprops.py:44), so the prop pair matches bit for bit -- Unblockable means Block never absorbs it and Unpowered means no Strength/Vulnerable/Weak scaling. No AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension in the file, so 4 is the non-ascension value. EXECUTED (`py audit/tools/relic_probes_b13.py royal-poison`): 80 HP -> 76 on turn 1, and a turn 2 entered with 99 Block takes no further loss. NOTE per binding rule 7: valueprops.py is not hashed by this record.
